blocks.text: Winwyn Marquez turned emotional as she opened up about experiencing mom guilt over being away from her only child, Luna, while staying inside the “Pinoy Big Brother” house. The actress-beauty queen was reminded of her family’s Christmas traditions when she and her fellow housemates were given ornaments to decorate their Christmas tree. “‘Yung anak ko po, three years straight, kahit baby siya, I make sure na kasama ko siya mag-ayos ng Christmas tree. Siya po ‘yung maglalagay ng star,” Marquez told Big Brother. “I kind of feel selfish being here,” she admitted. “Wala po kaming grand sa mga Christmas, but I […]...
